hunks.sol: *Let’s see what these bastards look like.*

hunks.baseline: Dragging his stiff body out of the thatched cottage, Old Man Jang’s eyes immediately fell on a crowd gathered like clouds.
hunks.sol: Dragging his stiff body out of the thatched cottage, Old Man Jang immediately spotted a crowd gathered like clouds.

hunks.baseline: There were hundreds of them, by his rough estimate. It looked as if everything in the village with legs—human or animal—had gathered in one place.
hunks.sol: There were hundreds of them by his rough estimate. It looked as though everything in the village with legs—human or animal—had gathered in one place.

hunks.baseline: It was a small, unremarkable village, so he knew most of the faces.
hunks.sol: It was a small village where everyone knew everyone, so most of the faces were familiar.

hunks.baseline: At Old Man Jang’s muttering, a familiar market merchant greeted him.
hunks.sol: At Old Man Jang’s muttering, a market merchant he recognized greeted him.

hunks.baseline: “By age, I’d be his father.”
hunks.sol: “Going by age, I could be his father.”

hunks.baseline: “You’ll get arrested for treason talking like that. Can’t you see the government soldiers over there?”
hunks.sol: “You’ll get arrested for treason talking like that. Can’t you see the government troops over there?”

hunks.baseline: “Government soldiers?”
hunks.sol: “Government troops?”

hunks.baseline: Following the merchant’s nod, Old Man Jang spotted dozens of government troops and a man dressed in an official robe—the county magistrate. His eyes narrowed.
hunks.sol: Following the merchant’s nod, Old Man Jang spotted dozens of government troops and the county magistrate dressed in his official robes. His eyes narrowed.

hunks.baseline: “That fellow never showed his face when the mounted bandits were prowling around, but now he’s dressed up in his official robes too? Is this important guest some high-ranking official?”
hunks.sol: “That fellow never showed his face when the mounted bandits were prowling around, but now he’s even put on his official robes? Is this important guest some high-ranking official?”

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, an uproar erupted from the assembled crowd.
hunks.sol: At that very moment, excited shouts erupted from the assembled crowd.

hunks.baseline: Old Man Jang turned his head in the direction of everyone’s gaze. When he saw fifty mounted riders charging toward them from the distance, their flags snapping in the wind, he finally understood who the important guests were.
hunks.sol: Old Man Jang turned to follow everyone’s gaze. When he saw fifty mounted riders galloping toward them in the distance, their flags snapping in the wind, he finally realized who the important guests were.

hunks.baseline: Old Man Jang had little interest in the affairs of the world, but he had heard the name of the Jin Family of Taiyuan until his ears rang.
hunks.sol: Old Man Jang had little interest in the affairs of the world, but even he had heard the name of the Jin Family of Taiyuan until his ears rang.

hunks.baseline: A prestigious family that had maintained its lineage for three hundred years, and the hegemon that held Shanxi Province in its grasp.
hunks.sol: A prestigious family with a three-hundred-year lineage, and the hegemon that held Shanxi Province in its grasp.

hunks.baseline: There were dozens of martial artists from the Jin Family of Taiyuan alone, all clearly visible. Yet the merchant immediately understood whom he meant.
hunks.sol: There were dozens of martial artists from the Jin Family of Taiyuan in plain sight, yet the merchant immediately understood whom he meant.

hunks.baseline: An awl in a pocket. The young man’s presence was like an awl tucked inside a pouch, bound to stand out wherever he went, so there was nothing strange about it.
hunks.sol: An awl in a pocket was bound to show. The young man stood out wherever he went.

hunks.baseline: My epithet and name rang out from every direction. Even though I’d already experienced this several times over the past few days, it still made me feel proud.
hunks.sol: My epithet and name rang out from every direction. Even though I’d already experienced this several times over the past few days, it still filled me with pride.

hunks.baseline: It was just like that thing. *Milky-skinned Jin Taekyung. We love you, Jin Taekyung.*
hunks.sol: This was that chant, wasn’t it? *Milky-skinned Jin Taekyung! We love you, Jin Taekyung!*

hunks.baseline: An idol fan club, the kind I’d only ever seen on music variety shows, was right in front of me. Smiling contentedly, I drew the [Unnamed Sword] from my waist.
hunks.sol: An idol fan club, the kind I’d only ever seen on music variety shows, was right in front of me. Smiling contentedly, I drew the Unnamed Sword from my waist.

hunks.baseline: A man for everyone, like something rated for all audiences—men and women, young and old.
hunks.sol: A man with all-ages appeal, beloved by men and women, young and old.
